originalTitle: Pretty Cure!: Kiseki no Henshin! Cure Mofurun!
alt: Eiga Mahou Tsukai Precure! Kiseki no Henshin! Cure Mofurun! /  Maho Girls PreCure! the Movie: The Miraculous Transformation! Cure Mofurun! 魔法つかいプリキュア！奇跡の変身！キュアモフルン！
description: Компания Toei Animation объявила, что премьера фильма по мотивам Mahoutsukai! Precure состоится в октябре 2016 года.

en: Mahoutsukai Precure! Kiseki no Henshin! Cure Mofurun!

Mirai and friends go to the Magical World to celebrate the Wishing Stone Festival, a once a century gathering where the titular stone grants one lucky customer's wish. When Mirai and Mofurun are seperated by a mysterious bear wizard, Mofurun's wish is granted and hijinks ensue.
ja: 魔法つかいプリキュア！奇跡の変身！キュアモフルン！
